subjects.witness_source:
def rgb_to_hsv(r, g, b):
    maxc = max(r, g, b)
    minc = min(r, g, b)
    rangec = maxc - minc
    v = maxc
    s = rangec / maxc
    rc = (maxc - r) / rangec
    bc = (maxc - b) / rangec
    if r == maxc:
        pass
    elif g == maxc:
        h = 2.0 + rc - bc
    h = h / 6.0 % 1.0
    return (h, s, v)
